# 10 Tips to Write an ATS-Friendly CV in 2025

In today's competitive job market, especially in the GCC region, having an ATS-friendly CV is crucial. Here are 10 essential tips to help you pass the initial screening:

## 1. Use Standard Headings
Stick to conventional section titles like 'Work Experience', 'Education', and 'Skills'. Avoid creative headings that might confuse the ATS.

## 2. Choose the Right Format
Use a simple, clean format with standard fonts like Arial or Calibri. Avoid tables, text boxes, or multiple columns.

## 3. Include Relevant Keywords
Analyze the job description and incorporate relevant keywords naturally throughout your CV.

## 4. Use Standard File Formats
Submit your CV in .docx or PDF format. Ensure the PDF is text-based, not an image.

## 5. Avoid Graphics and Images
ATS systems can't read images, so skip logos, photos, or infographics.

## 6. List Your Skills Clearly
Create a dedicated skills section with bullet points for easy parsing.

## 7. Include Full Job Titles
Use complete job titles rather than internal company codes or abbreviations.

## 8. Add Relevant Certifications
List certifications with their full names and issuing organizations.

## 9. Use Standard Date Formats
Format dates consistently (e.g., Jan 2023 - Present).

## 10. Proofread Thoroughly
Spelling errors can cause ATS systems to misinterpret your qualifications.
